This directory retains the license and modification notes for the FreeType
gray rasterizer distributed with Qt 4.4.3. The native implementation is
rust/crates/openvector/src/bitmap_raster/gray_raster.rs, a Rust translation of
OpenVector's modified src/vendor/freetype-raster/qgrayraster.c reference.
The Rust module retains the original copyright and FreeType Project License
attribution. The accompanying FTL.TXT is the unmodified upstream license.

OpenVector changes to the reference qgrayraster.c:
- Replace setjmp/longjmp pool exhaustion with an explicit worker overflow flag.
  The original band subdivision and retry remain the error recovery mechanism.
- Remove unused allocating raster constructors/destructors and the function
  table. The freestanding wrapper supplies the raster object and memory pool.
- The allocator retains the observed x86 reference's 3200-byte control quota
  independently of the modified worker layout. This preserves pool-growth
  retries and any pixels already composed before those retries.
- Remove unused stdio/stdlib includes and nonlocal-jump declarations.

Native Rust translation changes:
- Replace C cell pointers and pool storage with indexed Rust vectors.
- Preserve 32-bit wrapping arithmetic and logical pool accounting: 3200 bytes
  of control storage, 16-byte cells and 4-byte row pointers. These sizes model
  the reference rather than the native host's pointer sizes.
- Retain band subdivision, overflow retries and spans flushed before failure.
- Write one-byte coverage directly into the caller's buffer through the Rust
  worker instead of the reference's freestanding C wrapper.

The native build does not compile qgrayraster.c or its two private headers.
The headers remain unmodified in the development reference. No Qt application
or widget code is included. Verified upstream and modified source digests are
recorded in src/vendor/freetype-raster/source-identity.json in the development
checkout. The development C reference is not part of the npm archive.

Cargo compiles this Rust module into the openvector engine used by the CLI,
Node-API library and GPUI application. No FreeType or Qt installation is
required by this component.
